inspiration.observed_pattern: A reusable order-revenue CTE feeds two differently keyed customer summaries, and a final UNION ALL compares population counts, average and maximum lifetime value, average order count, and a conditional repeat-rate aggregate.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a buyer-account reconciliation report. MariaDB-compatible CTEs aggregate line totals once, produce person-keyed and per-order-account summaries, and combine them with UNION ALL; PostgreSQL FILTER aggregates become SUM(CASE ...) expressions, while all source tables, identifiers, labels, and values are newly authored.

fixture_notes: Buyers 701 and 703 each have two delivered orders, while buyer 702 has one. Each order has a distinct account reference, so the person-keyed summary reports repeat purchasing and the account-keyed comparison intentionally does not. A cancelled order and its line are excluded from both summaries.
determinism_notes: Buyer IDs, order IDs, account references, order statuses, line amounts, aggregation keys, labels, and UNION output ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE buyer_directory (buyer_id INT PRIMARY KEY, buyer_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE sales_orders (order_id INT PRIMARY KEY, buyer_id INT NOT NULL, account_ref INT NOT NULL, order_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE sales_lines (line_id INT PRIMARY KEY, order_id INT NOT NULL, line_total DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH order_revenue AS (SELECT o.buyer_id, o.account_ref, o.order_id, SUM(l.line_total) AS order_value FROM sales_orders AS o JOIN sales_lines AS l ON l.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.buyer_id, o.account_ref, o.order_id), per_buyer AS (SELECT buyer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(order_value) AS lifetime_value FROM order_revenue GROUP BY buyer_id), per_account AS (SELECT account_ref, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(order_value) AS lifetime_value FROM order_revenue GROUP BY account_ref) SELECT 'buyer_key' AS summary_key, COUNT(*) AS population, ROUND(AVG(lifetime_value), 2) AS average_value, ROUND(MAX(lifetime_value), 2) AS maximum_value, ROUND(AVG(order_count), 3) AS average_orders, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_rate FROM per_buyer UNION ALL SELECT 'account_key', COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(lifetime_value), 2), ROUND(MAX(lifetime_value), 2), ROUND(AVG(order_count), 3), ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM per_account ORDER BY summary_key
